description: The bar chart illustrates accuracy results (in percent) for three model categories, showing two measured conditions per model labeled in the legend as “Audio” and “Noise,” along with a horizontal dashed reference line. The horizontal axis contains the categorical model names, ordered left to right as Qwen2-Audio-Instruct, Audio-Reasoner, and Qwen-2.5-Omni, with no numeric scale. The vertical axis is labeled “Accuracy (%)” and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 60, with tick marks at regular 10-point intervals. For each model, there are two adjacent vertical bars: an “Audio” bar in blue and a “Noise” bar in purple. For Qwen2-Audio-Instruct, the Audio bar is approximately 30% and the Noise bar is approximately 23%. For Audio-Reasoner, the Audio bar is approximately 36% and the Noise bar is approximately 30%. For Qwen-2.5-Omni, the Audio bar is approximately 56% and the Noise bar is approximately 36%. The dashed horizontal line spans the plot at roughly 29% accuracy, and the bars are grouped by model with consistent side-by-side placement; no bars appear stacked, and no individual bars are specially outlined or annotated beyond the legend and the reference line.
